title: 3 Unforgettable Hours in Vancouver
includes: Sequence of Sightseeing in the Itinerary may change subjected to Driver/Tour Guide Discretion
requirements: Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Nestled between snow-capped mountains and the Pacific Ocean, Vancouver is a city of stunning natural beauty, diverse culture, and vibrant urban life. Discover iconic landmarks, scenic viewpoints, and hidden gems on a private, in-depth 3-hour tour led by a knowledgeable guide. 

The Pinnacle★ VIP Tour offers a large luxury SUV, senior expert guide, premium amenities, and optional highlights like VanDusen Botanical Garden, False Creek Ferry, and Vancouver Lookout. The Summit Experience provides a comfortable private SUV, professional guidance, and a flexible itinerary for a high-quality, personalized tour. Both options promise an unforgettable Vancouver experience.
